operations.summary: List L2 node members or nodes that can be added
operations.summary_zh: 查询 L2 节点成员或可添加节点
operations.description: Without available, or with it empty, returns the configuration's members ordered by sort and display_id (a missing configuration gives an empty list); with available=true the configuration must exist and the result is the scope's nodes that are not retired and not yet in any L2 configuration, ordered by display_id. Neither mode pages; available=false is invalid.
operations.description_zh: 未指定 available 或值为空时，按 sort、display_id 返回该配置的成员（不存在的配置得到空列表）；available=true 时，配置必须存在，返回本作用域未退役且尚未加入任何 L2 配置的节点，按 display_id 排序。两种模式均不分页；available=false 不合法。

params.name: target_scope_id
params.description: Tenant credentials may omit this value or repeat their own scope. Platform Bearer credentials omit it to target the platform scope; an explicit tenant scope is allowed only on read or decision operations.

params.name: config_id
params.description_zh: 只允许一个非零配置 UUID。

params.name: available
params.description: At most once; only true or an empty string is valid.
params.description_zh: 最多出现一次；仅 true 或空字符串合法。

responses.description: available=true returns the candidate nodes, otherwise the members; items is an empty array when there are none.
responses.description_zh: available=true 返回候选节点列表，否则返回成员列表；无数据时 items 为空数组。

operations.summary_zh: 批量添加 L2 节点成员
operations.description: Atomically adds 1 to 512 distinct nodes; the configuration, the optional condition and the non-retired nodes must belong to the caller's own scope. A node already in any L2 configuration returns 409. Each member starts at revision=1, enabled=true, weight=100, with sort from 0 in steps of 10 over the sorted node_ids; no ETag or Location is returned. Writes are bound by live manage permission and the idempotency key; If-Match must be "0".
operations.description_zh: 原子添加 1 至 512 个不重复节点；配置、可选条件和未退役节点必须属于自身作用域。已加入任一 L2 配置的节点冲突返回 409。每个成员初始 revision=1、enabled=true、weight=100，node_ids 排序后 sort 从 0 按 10 递增；不返回 ETag 或 Location。写入受实时管理权限和幂等键约束，If-Match 必须为 "0"。

params.name: target_scope_id
params.description: Tenant credentials may omit this value or repeat their own scope. Platform Bearer credentials omit it to target the platform scope; an explicit tenant scope is allowed only on read or decision operations.

params.name: If-Match
params.description: Must be the single exact quoted value "0".

fields.name: condition_id
fields.description: An undeleted match condition in the same scope; omitted or null means no condition, a zero UUID is invalid.
fields.description_zh: 同一作用域内未删除的匹配条件；省略或 null 表示不关联条件，零 UUID 不合法。

responses.description: Returns the created members or the original result of a completed request.
responses.description_zh: 返回创建的成员列表或已完成请求的原结果。

operations.summary: Replace an L2 node member's settings
operations.summary_zh: 替换 L2 节点成员设置
operations.description: id is the member UUID, not node_id. Replaces the condition, enabled state, weight and sort and increments the revision; an omitted or null condition_id clears the condition. enabled, weight and sort may not be omitted or null; writes are bound by the caller's own scope, live manage permission, revision and idempotency key. This item path does not support GET.
operations.description_zh: id 为成员 UUID，不是 node_id。完整替换条件、启用状态、权重和排序并递增修订；省略或传 null 的 condition_id 清除条件。enabled、weight、sort 不可省略或为 null；写入受自身作用域、实时管理权限、修订和幂等键约束。此单项路径不支持 GET。

params.name: id
params.description: Non-zero L2 node member UUID; not the node's node_id.
params.description_zh: 非零 L2 节点成员 UUID；不同于节点 node_id。

params.name: target_scope_id
params.description: Tenant credentials may omit this value or repeat their own scope. Platform Bearer credentials omit it to target the platform scope; an explicit tenant scope is allowed only on read or decision operations.

params.name: If-Match
params.description: Single quoted positive decimal current revision, for example "3".

fields.name: condition_id
fields.description: An undeleted match condition in the same scope; omitted or null means no condition, a zero UUID is invalid.
fields.description_zh: 同一作用域内未删除的匹配条件；省略或 null 表示不关联条件，零 UUID 不合法。

responses.description: Returns the updated member or the original result of a completed request.
responses.description_zh: 返回更新后的成员对象或已完成请求的原结果。

fields.name: ip_address
fields.description: IPv4 first, then IPv6; an empty string when there is neither.
fields.description_zh: 优先返回 IPv4，其次 IPv6；两者皆无时为空字符串。

fields.name: admin_state
fields.type: string: pending / active / draining / disabled / retired

operations.summary_zh: 删除 L2 节点成员
operations.description: id is the member UUID; only the membership is soft-deleted, not the node. Success or an idempotent replay returns 204 with no body; ETag keeps the revision at deletion. A missing resource returns 404, a revision conflict 412.
operations.description_zh: id 为成员 UUID，只软删除成员关系，不删除节点。成功或幂等重放返回 204，无响应体；ETag 保留删除时修订。不存在返回 404，修订冲突返回 412。
